_intent: STAGE 1: BOARD ENVELOPE (Define target PCB boundary: 70mm x 45mm)
_rule: Set initial rectangular board outline before placing components

_intent: STAGE 2A: CONNECTORS (User-facing USB Port on outer perimeter)
_rule: Connector opening MUST face outwards toward board edge (rotation 180 on left edge)

_intent: STAGE 2B: POWER AND THERMAL (Schottky Diode inline with USB 5V rail)
_rule: Place reverse-polarity/rectifier diode immediately downstream of connector

_intent: STAGE 2C: FILTER CAPACITORS (Bulk Input Capacitor for LDO)
_rule: Place within 1-3mm of LDO input pin to suppress voltage spikes

_intent: STAGE 2D: LINEAR REGULATOR (Thermal Heatsink Tab Placement)
_rule: TO-220/SOT-223 metal tab MUST face outward toward board edge for thermal dissipation

_intent: STAGE 2E: FILTER CAPACITORS (Bulk Output Capacitor for 3V3 Rail)
_rule: Place directly adjacent to LDO VOUT pin for low-impedance transient response

_intent: STAGE 2F: MICROCONTROLLER CORE (ESP32 RF Module)
_rule: PCB trace antenna MUST face board edge with no copper underneath for clear RF transmission

_intent: STAGE 2G: PULL-UP RESISTORS (Close Proximity to Target IC Pins)
_rule: Keep EN and IO0 strap pull-up resistors adjacent to their respective MCU pads

_intent: STAGE 2G: PULL-UP RESISTORS (Boot Strapping)
_rule: Maintain short trace length to minimize parasitic capacitance on high-impedance inputs

_intent: STAGE 2H: USER CONTROLS (Tactile Pushbutton Switch)
_rule: Place in accessible perimeter zone clear of tall thermal/electrolytic components

_intent: STAGE 3: GROUND REFERENCE PLANES (Bottom Layer Flood)
_rule: Inject polygon copper pour zones on back and front copper layers

_intent: STAGE 3: GROUND REFERENCE PLANES (Top Layer Flood)
_rule: Thermal relief connections automatically applied to IC ground pads

_intent: STAGE 3: REFILL COPPER POURS
_rule: Refill all zones to compute thermal spokes and copper clearance boundaries

_intent: STAGE 4: ROUTE PREPARATION AND QUALITY GATE
_rule: Purge orphaned traces, verify closed board outline, and check netclass widths

_intent: STAGE 5: DESIGN RULE CHECK (DRC)
_rule: Run automated kicad-cli DRC gate to guarantee 0 violations before export

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Lock critical parts
_rule: Lock connectors or mounting holes so subsequent relaxation passes will not move them

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Update component text field
_rule: Dynamically update value, MPN, or custom attributes directly in PCB memory
name: Value

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Fine-grained manual coordinate move
_rule: Nudge footprint relative to anchor or move between top and bottom layers

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Pure rotation
_rule: Rotate footprint in-place without altering X/Y coordinates

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Fit board outline dynamically
_rule: Automatically shrink-wrap Edge.Cuts rectangle around all placed parts with padding

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Manual high-current trace
_rule: Draw explicit wide power tracks (e.g. 0.8mm width) between specific coordinates

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Ground stitching via
_rule: Drop stitching vias to connect top and bottom ground planes for low return path inductance

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Dynamic track widening
_rule: Adjust track width by UUID without redrawing start and end points

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Unroute specific net
_rule: Delete all routed tracks for a single net before re-routing

_intent: APPENDIX: ADDITIONAL OPS REFERENCE - Delete item by UUID
_rule: Targeted deletion of any single track, via, zone, or drawing by unique UUID
